articles.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
articles.summary: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, helping organizations simplify procurement through existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.

articles.title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
articles.summary: Learn how OpenAI’s Control Room tracks model workloads across our research infrastructure and can rapidly stop them when safety or security concerns arise.

articles.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
articles.summary: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to govern and trust AI-generated code and Codex to ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team.

articles.title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
articles.summary: Kuken Industries uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of cooling tower drawings. Engineers can find the drawing for a repair in 4.5 minutes, down from nearly an hour.

articles.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
articles.summary: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.

articles.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
articles.summary: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.
